title: Singleton coefficient bounded by majority
statement: Let $n>0$, and let $f:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\{-1,1\\}$ have equal Fourier coefficients at all singleton sets. For every coordinate $i$, the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $\\{i\\}$ is at most the Fourier coefficient at $\\{i\\}$ of the majority function, which takes the sign of the sum of the coordinates and returns $1$ when that sum is zero.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
All singleton Fourier coefficients of $f$ are equal
$i$ is a coordinate in the cube
